source_message:
feat(training): add --force safety gate to train-agent.sh

- FLAG_FORCE=false default added to Defaults section
- Deploy safety gate (ADR-003): blocks --deploy when accuracy < 85%
  or avg_drift > 0.15; --force cannot override failed metrics
- When metrics pass + no --force: shows feedback_loop --report preview
  then waits for interactive [y/N] before deploying to GMKtec
- --force skips interactive prompt only when metrics pass (CI/CD use)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
